name: tw-deploy
description: **TIMEWARP SKILL** — deploy a generated app from its Aspire AppHost. The first deploy is one command, `dev deploy --target <t>`: publish, deploy, migrate when the app has a database, smoke the ingress, and open the app (`--no-browser` prints the URL). Targets: Docker Compose, Kubernetes/Helm, Azure (AKS or Azure Container Apps), and Azure Container Apps + Neon. `dev publish`, `dev deploy migrate`, `dev open`, and `dev deprovision` are one-step operator verbs (never CI). Also: kind, production sa
author: TimeWarpEngineering
